item.title: Fairly warm today, enjoy
item.description: Temps today are the warmest we'll see for a while. Mid 60's today - cooling off tonight and not warming back up from the overnight low for the daytime on Wednesday. Greg@660weather

item.title: From Bates County Clerk, Jami Page
item.description: The certification date for the April election is January 27th. Political subdivisions have until this date to turn in their candidate lists, ballot questions and/or no election statements to Jami Page, Bates County Clerk.

item.title: Another donation for The Wall That Heals
item.description: Money needed to help bring The Wall That Heals, a replica of the Vietnam Memorial in Washington, DC to Butler this Spring got another boost this week as Presiding Commissioner Jim Wheatley presented a donation to Bates County Clerk Jami Page.Those wishing to make a donation can contact Marsha Youngblood at 816-716-9217, John Gray at 816-547-4797 or Jami at 660-424-4215.

item.title: Accident in western Bates county
item.description: First responders are in route to an accident involving a van and an ATV on J highway at county road 6002 about a mile south of the Miami school.No other details are available however, use caution if traveling through the area.
